Cricket Coach Criticizes Gautam Gambhir Over Player Vaibhav Suryavanshi

The coach of young cricketer Vaibhav Suryavanshi has publicly criticized Gautam Gambhir, alleging that Gambhir, in his role as a mentor or coach, is benching Suryavanshi to give experience to new players. The coach stated that 15-year-old players are not meant for tasks like fetching water.
